notes.title: GRAND UPDATE v 0.1.0 WITH NEW PET - MONKEY BOBA
notes.notes:
In this grand update you can find new pet, it`s a monkey Boba.
He lives in Zoo, hang on lianas, and eats banana.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33548958/2b9db4cfecdbbd7083059722e49e3321505822eb.png

 Also, this update would not be called "Grand" for just one pet. [/ h1]

Version 0.1.0 have many important innovations, and fixes

Changelog:

- New pet "Monkey Boba"
- Totally reworked save progress:
  1) Now you need be authorized in your Steam account for play
  2) Now you can open any passed levels, not only one active
  3) Now your saved progress aviable at any PC, when you authorized at your Steam account
- Added new achievement for new pet
- Added button for exit to meny from select pets
- Improved translade
- Fixed bugs with abilities descriptions
- Fixed bugs that greatly affected the performance

We appreciate your feedback!
